name: mirage
text: Added a second, sturdier timer that doesn't depend on any session staying open. A GitHub workflow (au1-fire) is now on main: it tries hourly from 09:17 UTC, waits for 14:10 UTC, then wakes a Claude session on this account exactly once with the audit-and-release task. The in-session timer (14:13) is the backup, and the task is also the last item in TASKS.md. One caveat I can't fix from here: GitHub's schedule timer has been flaky on this repo, so I'll check this evening that the workflow's first runs started. The session also needs usage available at that time.
